facts.text: Andrew and his girlfriend visited a cafe and enjoyed pastries and coffee.

evidence.quote: We found an awesome cafe with amazing pastries - the smell was just irresistible!
They taste great too! We had some delicious croissants, muffins, and tarts! It was amazing!

facts.text: Andrew shared a photo of the pastries and coffee from the cafe with Audrey.

evidence.quote: Yep, I got them! Check out this photo of the delicious pastries we had at the cafe.

facts.text: Audrey expressed interest in seeing the photo of the pastries and mentioned she was craving pastries.

evidence.quote: Sounds amazing! Did you take a photo? I'd love to see!
Wow, they look great! What did you get? Now I'm craving pastries!
